primary_title: Expression of a cloned rat histamine H2 receptor mediating inhibition of arachidonate release and activation of cAMP accumulation
decision_basis: Histamine binds and activates cloned rat HRH2/H2 receptor in CHO cells, stimulating cAMP accumulation and modulating arachidonic-acid release
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat H2 receptor and CHO cAMP/arachidonate context; H2 coupling and native tissue effects are not generalized to other histamine subtypes or SCI.

primary_title: Cloning and functional expression of the human histamine H3 receptor
decision_basis: Histamine activates cloned human HRH3/H3 receptor in transfected cell lines, producing inhibition of forskolin-stimulated cAMP formation with H3 pharmacology
limitations_preserved: Preserve human H3 receptor and cAMP-inhibition context; splice/species pharmacology and presynaptic neuronal context are not generalized to SCI.

primary_title: Cloning and characterization of a novel human histamine receptor
decision_basis: Histamine activates cloned human HRH4/H4 receptor in HEK293 cells with a chimeric G-protein readout, producing receptor-selective calcium responses
limitations_preserved: Preserve human H4 receptor and chimeric-G-protein calcium assay; coupling is assay-dependent and no native glial or SCI inference is made.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4322923, Endothelin and endothelial dysfunction review
primary_title: Characterization of cloned human endothelin receptors
decision_basis: Endothelin-1 binds and activates cloned human EDNRB/ETB receptor in CHO cells, stimulating phosphatidylinositol hydrolysis
limitations_preserved: Preserve human ETB receptor and CHO binding/PI-hydrolysis context; ETB subtype pharmacology and native endothelial clearance functions are not generalized to SCI.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and functional expression of a cDNA encoding the human V1b vasopressin receptor
decision_basis: Arginine vasopressin binds and activates cloned human AVPR1B/V1b receptor in COS-1 cells and Xenopus oocytes, producing receptor-selective calcium-dependent chloride current
limitations_preserved: Preserve human V1b receptor and Xenopus/COS-1 context; pituitary tissue restriction and V1a/V2 subtype distinctions are not generalized to SCI.

primary_title: Development and characterization of a mouse cell line expressing the human V2 vasopressin receptor gene
decision_basis: Arginine vasopressin activates the cloned human AVPR2/V2 receptor in mouse L cells, producing receptor-specific stimulation of adenylyl cyclase
limitations_preserved: Preserve human V2 receptor and mouse L-cell adenylyl-cyclase context; kidney AQP2 and native epithelial physiology are not inferred for SCI.
